The record describes monitoring of employees' internet usage. In its decision on Comune di Bolzano, the Italian data protection authority (Garante) found that systematic monitoring of employee internet usage requires a DPIA under WP248's "systematic monitoring" criterion — even where the monitoring is not carried out on a large scale. That finding cuts against the company's position here. But the outcome depends on this company's own facts: whether the monitoring is organized and ongoing (systematic), or occasional and incidental. Section 1 records whether that trigger is satisfied. (Garante, Comune di Bolzano, decision of 13 May 2021; supervisory-authority decision — persuasive, non-binding outside its jurisdiction.)
